candidates.source_name: Montenegroberza AD (Montenegro Stock Exchange) — official site
candidates.why_relevant: Montenegro's only stock exchange and the statutory venue where listed banks (CKB/CKBP, Hipotekarna/HIBP, Lovcen banka/LUBA, Prva banka) trade. Root of all exchange-side issuer disclosure, trading data and listing decisions. NOTE: the domain 'montenegroberza.com' is NOT the exchange — it now resolves to an unrelated commercial frontier-markets content site; mnse.me is the real domain (email domain @mnse.me confirmed via company registries).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML scrape of the legacy ASP endpoints (/code/navigate.asp?Id=...); no JS required, stable query-string pattern. Weekly full crawl + daily delta on the news endpoint.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + corrected domain via business registry / chamber-of-commerce contact records

candidates.source_name: Montenegroberza — Vijesti / exchange & issuer announcements feed
candidates.why_relevant: Highest-value single page for this cell: carries Listing Committee decisions (Odbor za kotaciju), monthly bulletins, delistings, capital reductions, name changes, segment transfers and admission-to-trading decisions. This is where a bank's capital raise, symbol admission or suspension surfaces first. Observed real items dated Aug 2026 (XXIII sjednica Odbora za kotaciju; mjesečni bilten za jul 2026; EPCG capital reduction; LIMIT PRIME SECURITIES name change).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily scrape of the list page, then follow 'više' detail links matching /code/navigate.asp?Id=122&newsId=NNNN. No RSS observed — build own change-detection index keyed on newsId. Note newsId=1 returned 'Podaci ne postoje', so IDs are sparse/high-numbered; harvest IDs from the list page rather than enumerating.
candidates.discovered_via_method: site navigation crawl from exchange homepage
queries_used: Montenegroberza izvještaji emitenata banke

candidates.source_name: Montenegroberza — Simboli / listed-issuer symbol directory
candidates.why_relevant: Master list of all trading symbols (~416 observed) segmented by market tier (Prime, Prime Classic, Standard, Slobodno tržište, blok-poslovi, investment funds, debt symbols such as OB17-A / 1PBO1). Lets us build and maintain the authoritative universe of listed banks and bank-issued bonds for ME, and detect new admissions/segment moves.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly scrape of the symbol index; per-symbol pages follow /code/navigate.asp?Id=121&stockId=NNN and /code/navigate.asp?Id=14&stockId=NNN. Persist stockId->symbol->issuer mapping as a stable join key.
queries_used: Montenegroberza izvještaji emitenata banke

candidates.source_name: Montenegroberza — Mjesečni bilten (monthly market bulletin)
candidates.why_relevant: Periodic consolidated market statistics (turnover, price ranges, index composition, top issuers by turnover). Gives per-bank share-price and liquidity series without needing tick data, and is the cleanest structured artefact the exchange publishes. Observed: 'Mjesečni bilten za jul 2026. godine', 05/08/2026.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly: detect the bulletin item in the Vijesti feed, follow to the attachment (likely PDF/XLS) and archive. Exact attachment URL pattern not yet confirmed — resolve at first collection.
queries_used: Montenegroberza izvještaji emitenata banke

candidates.source_name: Montenegroberza — MONEX and MNSE10 indices
candidates.why_relevant: MNSE10 is the blue-chip index and MONEX the general benchmark; index revisions (redovna revizija indeksa) reveal which banks are gaining/losing free-float and liquidity weight. Index-revision notices are published as exchange announcements and mirrored by bankar.me.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape homepage index ticker daily; capture revision notices from the Vijesti feed. Caution: an index value dated 31/12/2010 appeared on the homepage, so validate freshness fields before ingesting.
candidates.discovered_via_method: homepage inspection + snowball to media mirror

candidates.source_name: Komisija za tržište kapitala Crne Gore (Capital Market Authority, KTK/CMA) — official site
candidates.why_relevant: The securities regulator that licenses issuers, approves prospectuses, keeps the issuer registry and enforces disclosure obligations under the Zakon o tržištu kapitala. Statutory disclosure channel distinct from CBCG prudential supervision — exactly the second channel this cell targets. Bilingual (/me/ and /en/ paths).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of /me/novosti, /me/regulativa, /me/ucesnici-na-trzistu, /me/obrasci; mirror /en/ equivalents for English titles.

candidates.source_name: CRPI — Centralni registar propisanih informacija (Officially Appointed Mechanism)
candidates.why_relevant: Montenegro's central storage mechanism for regulated information (the EU-Transparency-Directive style OAM). If it is populated, this is THE canonical single point where listed banks' periodic reports, material-event notices and major-holdings notifications are filed — higher value than any other source in this cell. Currently a bare 'CRPI Portal' shell with no visible public search; the operational filing side sits on scmnreporting.me.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual reconnaissance first (headless browser) to determine whether a public search/JSON API exists behind the shell; if it is login-gated, escalate to a formal access request to KTK. Do not assume dead — the shell rendered, so the host is live.

candidates.source_name: Zakon o tržištu kapitala (Capital Market Law) — KTK regulation library
candidates.why_relevant: Defines WHAT a listed bank must disclose and WHEN (prospectus approval, periodic reporting, inside/material-event information, major-holdings thresholds, corporate-governance code reporting). Essential to know which artefacts should exist so absences become detectable signals rather than blind spots. Two versions observed: the older consolidated law and an EU-aligned text.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off PDF ingest, re-check annually for amendments; also monitor /me/regulativa/pravila for rulebooks on corporate governance reporting by regulated-market issuers.

candidates.source_name: CKDD — Centralno klirinško depozitarno društvo AD Podgorica (CSD, ex-Centralna depozitarna agencija)
candidates.why_relevant: The central securities depository holding the dematerialised share register — the authoritative source for shareholder structure and ownership changes in listed banks, which is one of the three explicit targets of this cell. Publishes issuer and trading-symbol registers, debt-securities lists, and its own regulatory/business reports. Itself a listed issuer (CDAP), part-owned by CBCG and CKB.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the public register pages (/Home/Index/23 issuers, /Home/Index/66 trading symbols, /Home/Index/67 debt securities) and the report sections (/Home/Index/72, /73, /137). Full shareholder lists are NOT publicly searchable — they are issued on formal request to entitled parties against the CKDD price list; treat detailed ownership as request-only, and derive ownership changes from issuer/exchange notices instead.
candidates.discovered_via_method: actor-map reasoning (who registers ownership) + local-language search, snowballed from KTK market-participants page

negative_findings.description: The widely cited domain 'montenegroberza.com' is NOT the Montenegro Stock Exchange. Fetching https://www.montenegroberza.com/ returned an unrelated commercial investing-content site with sections 'Frontier Markets', 'RWA & Tokenization', 'Equities & ETFs', 'Offshore Access' and a guest-post/contributor solicitation — a classic expired-domain repurposing. Wikipedia and several aggregators still list it as the official site.
negative_findings.result_summary: The real exchange domain is mnse.me (confirmed independently via company-registry and chamber-of-commerce contact records showing info@mnse.me and @mnse.me staff addresses, and by fetching https://www.mnse.me/ which served live Montenegroberza trading data dated 25/08/2026).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collector seeded from Wikipedia or a stale link list would silently ingest SEO content as if it were exchange disclosure. This must be hard-blocklisted in the source registry.

negative_findings.description: The Montenegroberza site (mnse.me) has a flat, minimal navigation — Dobrodošli / Simboli / Vijesti / Kontakt. There is no separate 'Obavještenja emitenata' or 'Izvještaji emitenata' section distinct from the general Vijesti feed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Issuer material-event notices, listing-committee decisions and exchange notices are all mixed into a single /code/navigate.asp?Id=122 stream, and per-issuer disclosure history must be reconstructed by filtering that stream on issuer name/symbol.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design cannot rely on a per-issuer disclosure index; it needs entity resolution over free-text Montenegrin announcement titles, which raises extraction cost and recall risk for bank-specific events.

negative_findings.description: CRPI (Centralni registar propisanih informacija, crpi.me), referenced from the KTK site as the central storage mechanism for regulated information, rendered only a bare 'CRPI Portal' header with no navigable content or search. The www.crpi.me host additionally presented a TLS certificate whose SANs cover only scmnreporting.me hostnames (iam./portal./sp./www.), and https://www.scmnreporting.me/ returned HTTP 404 at the root.
negative_findings.result_summary: No public, searchable central repository of Montenegrin listed-issuer regulated information could be reached in this pass. Status is UNVERIFIED — hosts are live and certificates valid, so this reads as an auth gate or wrong entry path, not a dead service.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This would be the single highest-value source in the cell if accessible: one canonical feed of periodic reports, inside information and major-holdings notifications for all listed banks. Its absence forces reconstruction from the exchange feed plus individual bank websites, which is lossier and slower.

negative_findings.description: CKDD (the CSD) publishes issuer, trading-symbol and debt-securities registers, but its shareholder services page states that shareholder lists are prepared on request of a security owner or a group of owners entitled to inspect the list, against a price list. No public shareholder/ownership search interface was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Detailed shareholder structure for Montenegrin listed banks is request-gated and likely fee-bearing, not open data.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Shareholder structure is one of the three explicit targets of this coverage cell. Ownership-change tracking must therefore be built indirectly — from exchange block-trade and material-event notices, KTK prospectus documents, bank annual reports and trade press — with a known recall gap.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed, JSON API, or bulk-download endpoint was observed on either mnse.me or scmn.me for issuer announcements. mnse.me is a legacy classic-ASP application using query-string navigation (navigate.asp?Id=NNN&newsId=NNN / &stockId=NNN); scmn.me publishes registers only as dated-filename .xls files and documents as PDFs under /images/.
negative_findings.result_summary: All collection in this cell must be HTML/PDF/XLS scraping with custom change detection; no vendor-grade feed exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic engineering expectations and argues for filename/ID-diffing strategies plus document hashing to avoid duplicate ingestion across mirror domains (e.g. hipotekarnabanka.com vs hb.co.me vs ftp.hb.co.me).

negative_findings.description: The mnse.me homepage displayed a MONEX index value dated 31 December 2010 alongside live 25 August 2026 trading prices and market capitalisation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Parts of the exchange site carry stale or mis-labelled reference values.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Freshness validation and per-field date extraction are mandatory when ingesting mnse.me; naive scraping would mix a 2010 index level into a 2026 time series.

negative_findings.description: Attempting the detail-page pattern https://www.mnse.me/code/navigate.asp?Id=122&newsId=1 returned 'Podaci ne postoje' (data does not exist).
negative_findings.result_summary: News IDs are not densely enumerable from 1; historical back-fill by brute-force ID walking is unreliable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Archive back-fill for issuer announcements must harvest IDs from paginated list pages (or a web-archive crawl) rather than enumerating the ID space.

negative_findings.description: The exchange offers an EN toggle (/code/navigate.asp?Id=125, index.asp?jezik=en) but the underlying announcement content observed remained in Montenegrin/Serbian. KTK maintains parallel /en/ paths, though issuer documents (prospectuses, registers) are Montenegrin-only.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-language search alone would have surfaced almost none of the operative disclosure surface for this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that local-language collection and NLP (Montenegrin/Serbian, both Latin and Cyrillic-tolerant) is mandatory for this cell rather than optional.

coverage_gaps.description: CRPI / scmnreporting.me — the presumed official mechanism for storing regulated information — could not be entered in this pass (bare shell, cert-alias mismatch, 404 at reporting-portal root).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-browser reconnaissance against https://crpi.me/, https://portal.scmnreporting.me/ and https://sp.scmnreporting.me/ to map the public surface; if login-gated, send a written access enquiry to KTK (info@scmn.me, +382 20 442 800) asking whether a public search or bulk export of propisane informacije exists.

coverage_gaps.description: The exchange symbol index reports ~416 symbols but paginates; only the first ~20 were observed. The full set of bank and financial-institution issuers (equity symbols plus bank-issued bonds such as OB17-A, 1PBO1, 1NKBA, INBA) has not been enumerated, and symbol-to-legal-entity mapping is unconfirmed for most.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Paginate /code/navigate.asp?Id=121 fully, join against the KTK issuer register XLS (emitent*.xls) and the CKDD issuer register (/Home/Index/23), and produce a canonical ME listed-financial-issuer table with symbol, stockId, legal name, market segment and instrument type.

coverage_gaps.description: IR/disclosure sections were confirmed in detail only for Hipotekarna banka and CKB (and partially Prva banka). Lovćen banka, NLB Banka Podgorica, Universal Capital Bank, Adriatic Bank, Zapad banka, Erste, Addiko, Ziraat and others were identified as market actors but their listing status and issuer-disclosure pages were not individually verified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each entity in the CBCG/KTK bank list, verify (a) whether it has securities admitted to trading on MNSE, and (b) the exact URL of its izvještaji/obavještenja/skupština akcionara section. Prioritise those appearing in the exchange symbol index.

coverage_gaps.description: The seed term 'obavještenje o značajnom događaju' (material-event notice) did not surface a dedicated exchange or regulator section under that exact label. The operative Montenegrin terminology used in practice (e.g. 'propisane informacije', 'unutrašnja informacija', 'informacije koje se objavljuju', 'značajno učešće') has not been pinned to actual publication surfaces.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the exact disclosure-category vocabulary from Zakon o tržištu kapitala (both the older consolidated PDF and the EU-aligned text) and from the MNSE rulebook, then re-run local-language searches on those precise statutory labels to find the matching publication pages.

coverage_gaps.description: No back-series strategy exists for exchange announcements or monthly bulletins; the site offers no visible archive index and news IDs are not densely enumerable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess Wayback Machine coverage of mnse.me/code/navigate.asp?Id=122 and of the older montenegroberza.com content from before the domain was repurposed, to reconstruct pre-2026 issuer announcement history.

coverage_gaps.description: With CKDD shareholder lists request-gated and no visible major-holdings notification feed, threshold-crossing and change-of-control events in listed banks may go undetected between annual reports.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a composite detector: exchange block-trade symbols (*-B suffixes such as ATBA-B, PREN-B), listing-committee decisions, KTK prospectus publications, and investitor.me/bankar.me coverage — and separately request from KTK whether major-holdings notifications ('značajno učešće') are published anywhere public.

coverage_gaps.description: All observed sources used Latin-script Montenegrin/Serbian; no Cyrillic variants were tested, and diacritic-insensitive matching (Lovcen/Lovćen, izvjestaj/izvještaj, Hipotekarna/HIPOTEKARNA) was not systematically validated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add diacritic-folding and Latin/Cyrillic transliteration normalisation to the entity-matching layer, and run one confirmatory Cyrillic-script search pass over key terms to confirm no separate Cyrillic-only publication channel exists.

brief: Montenegro's listed-issuer disclosure channel is real but thin and technically primitive, and it runs on two institutions: Montenegroberza AD (correct domain mnse.me — NOT the repurposed montenegroberza.com, which is now unrelated SEO content) and the Komisija za tržište kapitala (scmn.me), with CKDD (ckdd.me) as the depository holding the share register. In practice all exchange-side issuer information — listing-committee decisions, admissions, capital reductions, delistings, monthly bulletins — flows through one undifferentiated Montenegrin-language news stream at /code/navigate.asp?Id=122, while the regulator contributes machine-readable issuer registers as dated .xls files, approved prospectus PDFs under /images/novosti/, and an annual capital-market report. The intended canonical repository, CRPI/scmnreporting.me, could not be entered (bare shell, certificate alias mismatch, 404 at root) and shareholder lists at CKDD are request-and-fee gated, so periodic reports and ownership structure must currently be reconstructed from individual bank IR sites (CKB quarterly management reports, Hipotekarna banka reports and prospectuses, Prva banka offering documents) supplemented by specialist local press (investitor.me, bankar.me). There are no RSS feeds or APIs anywhere in this cell; collection means Montenegrin-language HTML/PDF/XLS scraping with entity resolution over free-text announcement titles, and English-only search would have missed nearly all of it.
